note: Language bundles the publish workflow may build (ADR-0160 §5; ut-docs#4367). Each locale: the till locale code (also the plugin id suffix and locales/<code>.json), its Weblate language code, display name, script (ISO 15924; the per-string script check), human_spot_check (en/de/tr publish through the bundle-publish-human environment, ADR-0160 §4) and min_coverage (share of the union's keys the bundle must hold before it may publish: set for de/es/pt, whose 2.x bundle replaces an installed ut-plugin-language-* pack of ~3,470 strings under the same id — a thinner bundle would take German/Spanish/Portuguese away from every till until #4371 has imported the packs). The workflow's locale choice list must equal this list (tests/test_workflow.py).
